package.title: Working /settings surface: account, chat archive, theme, notifications, privacy, data usage

specification.intent: The six dead /settings items become a navigable settings surface backed by real state: Account (editable display_name/phone on new user columns, password change with cross-device logout, sign-out-everywhere), Chats (archive list with self-service rejoin reactivating left_at), Appearance (light/dark/system theme via CSS custom properties), Notification (sound + browser notifications), Privacy (server-side read-receipts flag gating history mark_read), Data Usage (per-user storage usage + auto-download gate on attachment previews).

requirements.title: Backend: user columns 011, profile/password/logout-all, rejoin, usage, receipts gate, name fallback
requirements.description: Migration 011_settings: users.display_name String(120) NULLable (NULL falls back to the email local-part in UserSearchItem.from_user, ContactResponse and to_member_brief; DM titles stored at creation keep their denormalized local-part — create_dm MAY prefer the target display_name for NEW dms, one owned line in services/chats.py), users.phone String(30) NULLable, users.send_read_receipts Boolean NOT NULL server_default '1'; segment roundtrip test with the EXPLICIT downgrade target '010_chat_leave'. PUT /auth/profile {display_name?, phone?, send_read_receipts?} (csrf, validate_origin; display_name trimmed 0..120 empty->NULL, phone NULL or 3..30). PUT /auth/password {old_password, new_password} (csrf): old verified 401 invalid_credentials, new 12..256, rehash, revoke ALL refresh tokens + reissue current-session cookies. POST /auth/logout-all (csrf): bump token_version AND BUILD the missing comparison: create_token already embeds a ver claim (core/security.py:46) and rotate_refresh_token compares it for refresh tokens, but get_current_user (core/deps.py:59-67) never checks it — add the users.token_version comparison there (core/security.py unchanged), then pin a real 401-after with a previously issued access token, revoke refresh, clear cookies. Auth responses (login/register/me/refresh) grow display_name/phone/send_read_receipts additive. POST /chats/{chat_id}/rejoin: reactivate the caller's own archived row (left_at -> NULL; share the reactivation helper with add_member), kicked/no-row 403 chat_membership_required, active idempotent 204, unknown 404, anonymous 401. GET /files/usage: caller's {total_bytes, file_count} one SUM/COUNT. MessageService.history skips mark_read when the VIEWER's send_read_receipts is false: the only consumer of chat_last_reads is the viewer's OWN unread badge (repositories/chats.py unread_counts -> GET /chats unread_count) — the gate keeps the VIEWER's own badge unread after reading; sender-visible read receipts are an explicit non-goal (no peer surface reads the marker today).
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (Account + Chats archive scope groups)

requirements.title: Theme: SCSS palette to CSS custom properties, dark overrides, theme module
requirements.description: variable.scss declares the palette as :root CSS custom properties; theme-dark.scss (new, imported from index.scss) overrides them under [data-theme='dark'] (curated dark palette; no comments in scss). Mechanical sweep scoped to COLOR tokens only (metrics like $tablet/$desktop stay SCSS variables — @media arithmetic cannot use var()): component scss files reference var(--token) instead of color tokens AND raw hex/rgb() color literals in component files are extracted to tokens (messenger/modal/chat/story-viewer/button/contacts/contact-item/chat-list-user carry ~27 such literals); exemption set = variable.scss (the token source), utils/mixins.scss, utils/scrollbar.scss, libs/** (mixins.scss IS stylelint-linted — the stated exemption is a plan choice, not a lint fact); the light-scrollbar-in-dark-mode artifact is documented as accepted unless trivially fixable via CSS scrollbar-color with vars. utils/theme.ts: 'light'|'dark'|'system', localStorage key chatty-theme, matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') listener in system mode, sets document.documentElement.dataset.theme ('dark' set / removed); bootstrapped from main.ts import; unit tests (persistence, listener, dataset).

requirements.title: Frontend logic: profile port (update/password/logout-all/usage), rejoin, preferences module
requirements.description: Profile port/adapter: changeProfile supported (PUT /auth/profile + csrf) with changePassword, logoutAll, fetchUsage (GET /files/usage own transport) additive; toAuthUser (auth/api/own.ts) maps the REAL display_name/phone (fallback local-part when null) plus send_read_receipts (AuthUser grows the flag — the old email-synthesis would revert Account edits); profile/password success refreshes the auth user and rejoinChat reaches the profile page via consumer-side setters wired in features/index.ts (the guard-exempt composition root, the logout-seam precedent); chats port/controller: rejoinChat(chatId) POST + csrf -> refetch; utils/preferences.ts: typed per-viewer prefs (sound default true, browserNotifications default false, autoDownload default true) with a subscriber bus, storage-failure tolerant; AppState.user carries display_name/phone.
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (logic underpinnings of all four groups)

requirements.title: Frontend UI: navigable settings sections + messenger delivery gates + docs
requirements.description: ProfilePage: the six sidebar items navigate the right pane (ProfileSettingsItem onClick + active modifier; section state in page props). Account: editable display_name/phone (validated), read-only email/login rows, password change (old/new/repeat, 12+ policy), Sign out, Sign out everywhere (confirm modal). Chats: archived list (leftAt) with «Вернуться» -> controller rejoin -> card undims via store. Appearance: light/dark/system radio live via theme.ts. Notification: sound + browser-notification toggles (permission request on enable). Privacy: read-receipts toggle -> PUT profile. Data Usage: fetched usage human-readable + auto-download toggle. Messenger delivery: WS message -> sound only when preference on; browser notification only when on + granted + document.hidden; attachment previews gated by autoDownload («Скачать» fallback, existing fileUrl). Docs: NEXT.md + progress_log with the cumulative follow-up registry. All new user text double-braced/escapeHtml.

specification.goal: A /settings page where every item works: real profile fields, password/security, archive management, theme, notifications, privacy and storage controls.
constraints: Layers only downward; guard-architecture --all --strict stays green; components never import features/controllers; cross-feature seams only in features/index.ts.
Migration 011 additive; segment test with the explicit downgrade target; heads == 011_settings; migrations 001-010 untouched.

All new/changed auth endpoints behind get_current_user + csrf + origin checks; password change must not kill the current session (reissue) but must kill other sessions; logout-all kills old access tokens (pinned 401-after).

No comments in new/edited scss (stylelint); theme sweep complete over BOTH $color tokens and raw hex/rgb literals outside the stated exemptions (variable.scss, mixins.scss, scrollbar.scss, libs) — grep gate.
utils/Store.ts user shape may gain display_name/phone (this plan owns the edit); existing suites green; counts grow from the real bases (mocha 450 / pytest 230 +4 known Windows ingestion failures).
nonGoals: email/login change (email IS the login — separate security-heavy feature)
per-chat notification settings; server push of profile changes
eliminating the dark-mode first-frame flash (inline bootstrap script)
WebAudio/Notification end-to-end tests (jsdom lacks the APIs — gate tests with stubs)
per-chat storage breakdown; deleting files from Data Usage
sender-visible read receipts (no peer surface reads chat_last_reads — the receipts gate is viewer-own-badge semantics only)
specification.scope: backend user columns + auth/chats/files endpoints + receipts gate + pytest; theme infrastructure + sweep + theme module; profile/chats logic + preferences module; settings page sections + messenger delivery gates + docs; evidence under work/2026-11-01-settings/.

criteria.title: Backend settings surface proven by pytest

securityGates.statement: PUT /auth/profile, PUT /auth/password, POST /auth/logout-all behind get_current_user + require_csrf + validate_origin (anonymous 401 / csrf-reject pinned); password change never weakens the current session while killing others (pinned); logout-all invalidates previously issued access tokens (401-after pinned); rejoin touches only the caller's own membership row.
All new user-visible strings (display_name, phone, usage numbers, section labels) render through double braces or escapeHtml builders; no raw triple-brace injection outside pre-escaped builders.
